title: Top Office Chairs for Long Workdays & Back Pain (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the cited sources (CNET, PCMag, ExpertReviews).
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no price information is included.

verdict.line: Picture a long day at the desk: the Aeron’s breathable mesh and adjustable lumbar support keep you comfortable and reduce back strain. It wins because it offers the most comprehensive ergonomic features among the picks, and its adjustable seat height and tilt are the only ones that match the Vantum’s 12‑year warranty. The catch: it is the most expensive option.
